page_title: WER 1-2 HEI | Werder Bremen v Heidenheim 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+6' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+6' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
90+6' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Werder Bremen have a corner.
90+4' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Omar Haktab Traore.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
87' Here comes a substitution. Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Felix Agu.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) will replace Senne Lynen.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
86' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
84' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:8.
81' Here is a change. Eren Dinkci is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
81' A substitution has been made. Marvin Pieringer goes off and Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) comes on.
80' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.

79' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save. The referee blows his whistle, Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
78' The attendance is 41000.
78' A player from Heidenheim commits a rough challenge. Robert Schroder blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

77' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Kevin Muller pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

76' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
76' Heidenheim will take a corner kick.
75' The ball is cleared after Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
75' Great teamplay by Heidenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Werder Bremen.
73' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) dribbles into the box, but Kevin Muller is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
72' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Kevin Muller.
70' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
70' Referee Robert Schroder makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
69' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
69' Werder Bremen hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
67' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
66' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Olivier Deman will be replaced by Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen).
66' Justin Njinmah will be replaced by Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
62' Heidenheim move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
58' Neat passing move from Heidenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.
56' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
56' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
53' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
51' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
50' Werder Bremen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) and Tim Kleindienst is off.
46' Robert Schroder blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Robert Schroder didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Werder Bremen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
43' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) has tested the patience of referee Robert Schroder and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' Ole Werner is forced to make a change. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Julian Malatini.
39' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen).
31' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
30' A quickly taken corner by Heidenheim.

30' The game is pretty dull as Heidenheim are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Heidenheim have a free kick.

25' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Schroder no option but to blow his whistle. Werder Bremen get a free kick.
24' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Werder Bremen have a free kick.

19' 1 - 2 Senne Lynen sends a superb cross into the box. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the right post, leaving Kevin Muller beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:2.
18' 0 - 2 Goal! Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
16' Werder Bremen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

12' 0 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the roof of the net, increasing the score of today's match – 0:1.
12' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

6' It looks like Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) saw red with that tackle. Robert Schroder won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

4' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. Unfortunately, he only found the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
2' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Schroder had an easy-decision to make.

The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
